_README: A ledger of claims this project has retracted, superseded, or downgraded to unverified,
and of citations it has ruled unsuitable. It is the machine-readable counterpart to the
correction notes written in prose in PROJECT.md.
It exists because a correction that lands in one file does not propagate to the others.
PROJECT.md recorded on 2026-09-22 that the Davari random-label attribution is unverified
and that the ICLR 2023 venue was dropped pending verification; CLAUDE.md, README.md and
both proposal files continued to assert both. The n = 20 rerun on 2026-09-21 replaced the
2.94x / 1.13x seed-stability figures; csci-proposal-FINAL.md still states them as current
fact and csci-proposal-draft.md states them in its introduction while reporting the
corrected pair later in the same document.
Every entry here names the correction that created it and the file that records that
correction in prose. analysis/consistency_checks.py reads this file and reports any
deliverable that contradicts it. The ledger states what was retracted; it does not decide
what to do about a hit, which remains a matter for the author.
An entry is removed when the underlying claim is verified rather than when it becomes
inconvenient. Removing one is a visible diff, which is the same protection the commit

reason: A dated coursework artifact that was submitted on 2026-09-14, before the n = 20 rerun
and before control C-6. It is a historical record of what was believed at the time and
is not retroactively corrected, so the superseded-value check skips it. Checks that
concern citations still apply, because a citation was either verified or it was not.

heldout_markers: inputs it did not train on

banned_citations.reason: Unrefereed preprint containing no empirical work. Known to be real but unsuitable as authority.
Unrefereed preprint. Known to be real but unsuitable as authority.

retracted_attributions.name: davari-random-label-arm
reason: An earlier entry credited Davari et al. (arXiv:2210.16156) with a random-label
memorization arm and linear-probe accuracies of roughly 70% versus 10%. The abstract
contains none of those and was checked directly. The paper body has not been read, so
the attribution is unverified. The general CKA-unreliability point stands on the
abstract alone and may still be cited.

retracted_attributions.name: davari-venue-iclr-2023
reason: The venue was asserted without checking and has been dropped pending verification.
Cite the arXiv identifier until the venue is confirmed.

retracted_attributions.name: founder-identity-beyond-frequency
reason: Control C-4S ran on 2026-10-20 under a rule committed 2026-10-15 and failed both
gates. Founder generation-0 predicted class frequency alone correlates with death
generation at 0.4721 over 10000 within-chain permutations, p = 1e-4, which is a
larger correlation than the 0.3625 transmitted-count effect C-4T rests on. The
committed consequence is explicit: the surviving-alphabet overlap cannot be
attributed to founder identity beyond frequency without a frequency-matched
overlap null, and that null becomes a prerequisite for any further statement about
founder identity rather than an improvement to the statistics.
The 2.12x same-founder overlap ratio is not withdrawn and the n = 20 measurement
stands. What is withdrawn is reading it as evidence of founder identity without
saying what it adds over founder class frequency. Either phrasing of the claim may
be restored once analysis/overlap_stats.py's frequency_matched_null has been run on
logs/seed_stability_n20.json, which needs no new training and is already written.
The patterns here match the two sites where the ratio is asserted as a
founder-identity result and deliberately not the paragraphs that record its
correction history, where stating the number is the point.

superseded_values.reason: Same-founder Jaccard ratio from five chains with ten pairwise comparisons and no interval. The n = 20 rerun (logs/seed_stability_n20.json) gives 2.12x against the empirical null, with a 95% interval.
Cross-founder Jaccard ratio from five chains. The n = 20 rerun gives 0.93x against the empirical null.

Generation-20 agreement with generation 0 at tau = 1.0, B = 4096, measured on the training pool. Control C-6 established that the published pilot agreements are training metrics; the held-out generation-25 value is 0.130.
Generation-20 training-pool agreement at tau = 0.5, B = 4096. Held-out generation-25 value is 0.138; the gap of 0.081 breached the preregistered C-6 threshold.

Generation-20 training-pool agreement under argmax transmission. The held-out generation-25 value is 0.167, a gap of 0.487, and the gap at generation 1 is 0.753. Argmax preserves the founder's memorized lookup table on memorized points, not its function.

evidence: cka_prev is written only by spike_iterated_distill.py and appears only in the six
pilot .jsonl logs, all of which are training-pool runs. controls/c6_probe_pool.py
computes cka_gen0 on the probe pool and never computes a consecutive-generation CKA.
No held-out consecutive-generation CKA value exists anywhere in this repository.
reason: Pairing a consecutive-generation CKA with a held-out agreement figure presents two
measurements from different pools as one observation. The CKA figure that is unaffected
by the pool is cka_gen0 (0.642 training against 0.650 held-out), which is a different
quantity from the one the claim rests on.
Each arm of the seed-stability sweep yields two ratios: observed Jaccard over the
analytic random-subset baseline, which the log prints, and observed Jaccard over the
empirical null, which analysis/seed_stability_stats.py computes and the deliverables
quote. Both are correct and they are measured against different nulls.
CLAUDE.md requires that two sources which disagree be reported side by side and never
quietly resolved into one. Arm A's pair (1.99x analytic, 2.12x empirical) is flagged in
CLAUDE.md and .claude/fence_test.md. Arm C's pair (1.73x, 1.27x) is discussed in
PROJECT.md. Arm B's analytic ratio has never appeared in any deliverable.
